variables.name: font/family/GT Walsheim
variables.description: Sans. Headings H3–H6, paragraph, labels, numericals.

variables.name: font/kerning/none
variables.description: Default letter spacing (0%) for all non-numerical styles.

variables.name: font/kerning/num
variables.description: Letter spacing (%) for numerical styles N1–N6.

variables.name: Border/hairline
variables.description: 0.7px hairline stroke used by borders and separators.

variables.name: surface/base
variables.description: Page background — everything sits on this.

variables.name: surface/widget
variables.description: Widget / card surface on the base, carries Shadow/1.

variables.name: surface/sunken-1
variables.description: One level sunk into its parent surface.

variables.name: surface/sunken-2
variables.description: Two levels sunk into its parent surface.

variables.name: surface/raised
variables.description: Raised element on a surface, carries Shadow/1.

variables.name: surface/focus
variables.description: Focused / highlighted raised element, carries Shadow/2.

variables.name: content/primary
variables.description: Default text and icons. 14.99:1 on surface/base.

variables.name: content/quaternary
variables.description: Decorative / metadata only. 3.41:1 — never body text.

variables.name: content/on-color
variables.description: Text on solid brand/status fills. Audit per fill — fails on status/success/solid for small text.

variables.name: status/success/solid
variables.description: White ink 4.26:1 — large text / UI only.

effectStyles.name: Shadow/1
effectStyles.description: Resting surface lift. Blur 100, y 4, spread 12, 5%.

effectStyles.name: Shadow/3
effectStyles.description: Strongest lift (floating / dark card). Blur 85, y 2, spread 7, 11%.
